versions.changelog:
BaZi reading (Four Pillars) interpretation skill initial release:

- Provides cultural and reflective BaZi (八字) chart readings: outlines pillars, day master, five elements, and analytic themes.
- Guides assistant to request accurate birth data and clarify assumptions (Gregorian/lunar, time, location).
- Stresses non-fatalistic, ethical framing; avoids determinism and harmful predictions.
- Recommends external calculators for precise stems/branches and luck cycles when needed.
- Output structure includes chart snapshot, element balance, thematic insights, timing notes, and disclaimers.
